const STATE = {{ selectedTicker: null, }}; function formatMarketCap(n) {{ if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return '—'; const abs = Math.abs(n); const units = [ ['T', 1e12], ['B', 1e9], ['M', 1e6], ['K', 1e3], ]; for (const [suffix, v] of units) {{ if (abs >= v) return `${{d3.format('.2f')(n / v)}}${{suffix}}`; }} return d3.format(',')(Math.round(n)); }} async function loadStockDescriptions() {{ try {{ const res = await fetch('data/stock-descriptions.csv', {{ cache: 'no-store' }}); const text = await res.text(); return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType); }} catch (err) {{ console.warn('Falling back to embedded stock-descriptions.csv (fetch failed).', err); return d3.csvParse(EMBEDDED_STOCK_CSV, d3.autoType); }} }} function normalizeStocks(rows) {{ return rows.map(r => {{ const ticker = (r.ticker ?? '').trim(); const sector = (r.sector ?? '').trim() || 'Unknown'; const fullName = (r['full name'] ?? '').trim(); const marketCap = Number.isFinite(r.marketCap) ? +r.marketCap : NaN; const isETF = sector === 'ETF' || !Number.isFinite(marketCap); return {{ ticker, sector, fullName, marketCap: Number.isFinite(marketCap) ? marketCap : null, isETF, }}; }}).filter(d => d.ticker); }} function buildLegend(sectors, color) {{ const legend = d3.select('#legend'); legend.selectAll('*').remove(); legend.append('div') .attr('class', 'legend__title') .text('Sector'); const items = legend.selectAll('.legend__item') .data(sectors, d => d) .enter() .append('div') .attr('class', 'legend__item'); items.append('div') .attr('class', 'legend__swatch') .style('background', d => color(d)); items.append('div') .attr('class', 'legend__label') .text(d => d); }} function setSelection(ticker) {{ STATE.selectedTicker = ticker; d3.selectAll('.bubbleNode') .classed('selected', d => d.ticker === ticker); d3.selectAll('tr.stockRow') .classed('selected', d => d.ticker === ticker); const row = document.querySelector(`tr.stockRow[data-ticker="${{ticker}}"]`); if (row) row.scrollIntoView({{ block: 'nearest' }}); }} function renderTable(stocks) {{ const tbody = d3.select('#tableBody'); const rows = tbody.selectAll('tr.stockRow') .data(stocks, d => d.ticker); rows.exit().remove(); const rowsEnter = rows.enter() .append('tr') .attr('class', 'stockRow') .attr('data-ticker', d => d.ticker) .on('click', (event, d) => setSelection(d.ticker)); rowsEnter.append('td').attr('class', 'ticker'); rowsEnter.append('td').attr('class', 'name'); rowsEnter.append('td').attr('class', 'sector'); rowsEnter.append('td').attr('class', 'num marketCap'); const merged = rowsEnter.merge(rows); merged.select('td.ticker').text(d => d.ticker); merged.select('td.name').text(d => d.fullName || '—'); merged.select('td.sector').text(d => d.sector || '—'); merged.select('td.marketCap').text(d => formatMarketCap(d.marketCap)); }} function renderBubbles(stocks) {{ const wrap = document.getElementById('bubbleWrap'); const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect(); const width = Math.max(520, Math.floor(rect.width)); const height = Math.max(520, Math.floor(rect.height)); const svg = d3.select('#bubbleSvg'); svg.selectAll('*').remove(); svg.attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${{width}} ${{height}}`); const tooltip = d3.select('#tooltip'); const sectors = Array.from(new Set(stocks.map(d => d.sector))).sort(d3.ascending); const color = d3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(sectors) .range(sectors.map((s, i) => d3.interpolateRainbow((i + 0.15) / (sectors.length + 0.3)))); buildLegend(sectors, color); const nonEtfCaps = stocks.filter(d => !d.isETF && Number.isFinite(d.marketCap)).map(d => d.marketCap); const capExtent = d3.extent(nonEtfCaps); const rScale = d3.scaleSqrt() .domain([Math.max(1, capExtent[0] ?? 1), capExtent[1] ?? 1]) .range([14, 48]) .clamp(true); const ETF_R = 16; // Compute fixed cluster centers in a small ring around the canvas center. const cx = width / 2; const cy = height / 2; const ringR = Math.min(width, height) * 0.22; const centers = new Map(); sectors.forEach((s, i) => {{ const a = (i / sectors.length) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2; centers.set(s, {{ x: cx + ringR * Math.cos(a), y: cy + ringR * Math.sin(a), }}); }}); // Stable initial positions: based on sorted tickers. const nodes = stocks .slice() .sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.ticker, b.ticker)) .map((d, i) => {{ const c = centers.get(d.sector) ?? {{ x: cx, y: cy }}; const r = d.isETF ? ETF_R : rScale(d.marketCap); const phi = i * 0.61; const rad = 8 + (i % 12) * 1.7; return Object.assign({{}}, d, {{ r, x: c.x + Math.cos(phi) * rad, y: c.y + Math.sin(phi) * rad, }}); }}); const g = svg.append('g'); const node = g.selectAll('g.bubbleNode') .data(nodes, d => d.ticker) .enter() .append('g') .attr('class', 'bubbleNode') .style('cursor', 'pointer') .on('click', (event, d) => setSelection(d.ticker)); node.append('circle') .attr('r', d => d.r) .attr('fill', d => color(d.sector)) .attr('fill-opacity', d => d.isETF ? 0.55 : 0.78) .attr('stroke', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.30)') .attr('stroke-width', 1); node.append('text') .text(d => d.ticker) .attr('text-anchor', 'middle') .attr('dy', '0.35em') .attr('fill', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.94)') .attr('font-weight', 720) .attr('font-size', d => Math.max(9, Math.min(14, d.r * 0.55))); // Tooltip only for non-ETFs (per requirement). node .filter(d => !d.isETF) .on('mousemove', (event, d) => {{ tooltip .classed('visible', true) .attr('aria-hidden', 'false') .html( `
${{d.ticker}}
` + `
${{d.fullName}}
` + `
Sector: ${{d.sector}}
Market cap: ${{formatMarketCap(d.marketCap)}}
` ) .style('left', `${{event.pageX + 12}}px`) .style('top', `${{event.pageY - 12}}px`); }}) .on('mouseleave', () => {{ tooltip.classed('visible', false).attr('aria-hidden', 'true'); }}); // Force simulation with sector clustering. const sim = d3.forceSimulation(nodes) .force('x', d3.forceX(d => (centers.get(d.sector) ?? {{ x: cx }}).x).strength(0.18)) .force('y', d3.forceY(d => (centers.get(d.sector) ?? {{ y: cy }}).y).strength(0.18)) .force('collide', d3.forceCollide(d => d.r + 2).iterations(2)) .force('charge', d3.forceManyBody().strength(-10)) .force('center', d3.forceCenter(cx, cy)); // Run a fixed number of ticks for a stable settled layout. for (let i = 0; i < 260; i += 1) sim.tick(); sim.stop(); node.attr('transform', d => `translate(${{d.x}},${{d.y}})`); // Selection styling const selStyle = svg.append('style').text(` .bubbleNode.selected circle {{ stroke: rgba(255, 215, 106, 0.95); stroke-width: 3px; filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)); }} `); // Hide tooltip if click selection happens. svg.on('click', () => tooltip.classed('visible', false)); }} async function main() {{ const rows = await loadStockDescriptions(); const stocks = normalizeStocks(rows); // Ensure the table is exactly the 50 entries. const tableStocks = stocks.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.ticker, b.ticker)); renderTable(tableStocks); renderBubbles(stocks); // When resizing, recompute the bubble layout. const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => renderBubbles(stocks)); ro.observe(document.getElementById('bubbleWrap')); }} main().catch(err => {{ console.error(err); const legend = document.getElementById('legend'); if (legend) legend.textContent = 'Failed to load or render data.'; }}); """ Path('/root/output/js/visualization.js').write_text(js, encoding='utf-8') print('Wrote /root/output/js/visualization.js') PY # Quick sanity check: ensure files exist find /root/output -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort
